***Package descriptions*** 

| No  | Package  | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01  | /config  | Contains configuration settings for the backend system such as environment variables, database connection setup, and other application-level configurations. |
| 02  | /constant  | Stores constant values used across the application to avoid hardcoding values and improve maintainability. |
| 03  | /controllers  | Handles incoming HTTP requests and responses. Controllers receive requests from routes, process input data, call services, and return responses to the client. |

04 /jobs Contains scheduled background tasks (cron jobs) that run automatically at specified intervals to handle time-sensitive 

SAMS – Report4 (Software Design Document) Page 10

|  |  | business operations, such as expiring unpaid bookings, sending automated reminders, and transitioning contract statuses. |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| 05  | /middlewares  | Contains middleware functions used in the request processing pipeline, such as authentication, authorization, error handling, and logging. |
| 06  | /models  | Defines the data models and database schemas used in the application. These models represent entities stored in the database and interact with the data layer. |
| 07  | /routes  | Defines API endpoints and maps HTTP requests to corresponding controller functions. |
| 08  | /service  | Implements the core business logic of the application. Services process data, interact with models, and provide reusable logic for controllers. |
| 09  | /utils  | Provides helper functions and reusable utilities that support different parts of the application. |
| 10  | /validators  | Contains validation logic to verify request data before it is processed by controllers. |
